name: Gears of War
strap: Meet Delta Squad. Choose your first fight.
description: Where to start Gears of War, why each entry point works, what to skip, and the lore and characters worth knowing.
intro: Gears works best when you care about the squad. Its original trilogy, later generation, and prequels offer different beginnings without requiring novels or competitive play.
recommendation: Start the first Gears of War campaign, using Reloaded if it suits your platform. Gears 4 is a workable fresh-generation alternative. E-Day is a new origin story, currently in early access ahead of its 6 October 2026 general launch.
basics: The setting is Sera, a human world devastated by war; it is not Earth.
The Locust emerge from underground and overwhelm human settlements. The first game begins years into the war.
Co-op can make the squad experience more immediate. Horde, competitive modes, collectibles, and books are optional.

entries.title: Gears of War / Reloaded
entries.audience: I want the squad’s original journey
entries.why: A rescue and a clear military objective introduce Marcus, Dom, and their world through action. Reloaded retells this opening story.
entries.need: Human survivors are fighting the Locust on Sera. Marcus is returning to military service.
entries.skip: Novels, comics, multiplayer, Judgment, and the prequels.
entries.tradeoff: Later parts of the original trilogy have different platform availability. Check access before planning a three-game run.
entries.next: Play Gears 2, then Gears 3. Add prequels when you want more about the squad.

entries.title: Gears of War 4
entries.audience: I want a more modern fresh-generation start
entries.why: JD, Kait, and Del introduce a new threat after the original war. Older characters provide context without replacing this group’s story.
entries.need: The old war ended; new settlements and political restrictions shape life on Sera.
entries.skip: Full original-trilogy playthroughs and all external media.
entries.tradeoff: Marcus’s personal history has more weight if you know the earlier games. The new arc continues into Gears 5.
entries.next: Use the optional trilogy recap, then play Gears 5.

entries.title: Gears of War: E-Day
entries.audience: I want to see the invasion’s beginning
entries.why: Its prequel premise introduces a younger Marcus and Dom at the point their world changes. No later campaign is needed to understand that setup.
entries.need: Emergence Day is the first large-scale Locust attack on Sera.
entries.skip: Every previous game and the novels.
entries.tradeoff: As reviewed on 3 October 2026, early access is available but general launch is 6 October. This recommendation is based on the verified premise, not an assumed ending.
entries.next: Continue to Gears of War for the established later squad story when ready.

events.title: Gears of War
events.premise: Marcus Fenix rejoins Delta Squad in a campaign against the Locust.
events.recap: The squad deploys the Lightmass Bomb against the underground enemy, winning an immediate victory without ending the war.
events.why: Original starting point; Ultimate Edition and Reloaded are versions of this campaign.

events.title: Gears of War 2
events.premise: Delta enters the underground struggle as human cities fall.
events.recap: Dom finds Maria but cannot rescue the life she once had. The campaign culminates in sinking Jacinto, a desperate answer to the subterranean threat.
events.why: Follow the first game for the squad’s emotional stakes.

events.title: Gears of War 3
events.premise: The surviving squad seeks an answer to the Locust and Lambent threat.
events.recap: Dom sacrifices himself. Adam Fenix’s countermeasure ends the immediate Locust/Lambent war at terrible personal cost.
events.why: The conclusion of the original trilogy.

events.title: RAAM’s Shadow
events.premise: A different squad confronts the Locust assault on Ilima.
events.recap: The evacuation gives the war a civilian perspective alongside the campaign’s battles.

events.title: Gears of War: Judgment
events.premise: Kilo Squad faces an invasion and a military tribunal.
events.recap: Baird’s defiance of orders is judged against the necessity of stopping Karn. The accompanying Aftermath campaign returns to a period within Gears 3.
events.why: Optional Baird/Cole story; its framing jumps between testimony and action.

events.title: Gears of War 4
events.premise: JD, Kait, and Del investigate attacks on their community.
events.recap: The Swarm emerge as a transformed continuation of the old threat. Kait’s family connection to Myrrah changes what the conflict means for her.
events.why: Alternative modern entry after a short trilogy recap.

events.title: Gears 5
events.premise: Kait pursues the truth about her family while the COG prepares for war.
events.recap: Kait’s connection to the Locust’s origins comes into focus. The Swarm gains a queen, and a late choice leaves either JD or Del alive.
events.why: Play after Gears 4; outcomes are not treated as one fixed future here.

events.title: Gears Tactics
events.premise: Gabe Diaz leads a squad against a Locust scientist’s campaign.
events.recap: Ukkon is defeated; Gabe’s family ties connect this prequel to Kait’s later generation.
events.why: Optional tactical game, with different play from the shooters.

events.title: Hivebusters
events.premise: A new three-person team tests a way to attack Swarm hives.
events.recap: The squad’s operation establishes a different approach to entering and destroying a hive.
events.why: A compact optional campaign for a new cast.

events.title: Gears of War: E-Day
events.premise: A younger Marcus and Dom face the beginning of the Locust invasion.
events.why: A new origin route; no unverified campaign resolution is supplied.

characters.name: Marcus Fenix
characters.motivation: Duty to his squad competes with a history of personal loss and institutional distrust.
characters.relationships: Dom is his closest friend; Adam Fenix and JD connect different generations.

updates.text: Victory over the old threat costs him Dom and his father.

characters.name: Dominic Santiago
characters.motivation: His loyalty is inseparable from the search for his family.
characters.relationships: Maria and Marcus give the war its most personal stakes.

updates.text: Finding Maria does not bring the reunion he hoped for.
He sacrifices himself to save the squad.

characters.name: Damon Baird
characters.motivation: Scepticism and expertise make him question plans that others accept on authority.

characters.name: Augustus Cole
characters.role: A former sports star and soldier
characters.motivation: His energy sustains the squad, even when the world cannot sustain his old identity.
characters.relationships: Baird and Delta Squad form his wartime community.

characters.name: Anya Stroud
characters.motivation: She keeps military work connected to the people carrying it out.
characters.relationships: Marcus and Delta Squad are central to her story.

characters.name: JD Fenix
characters.role: A soldier of the later generation
characters.motivation: He wants a life defined by his choices rather than his father’s legend.
characters.relationships: Marcus, Kait, and Del complicate that independence.

characters.name: Kait Diaz
characters.role: An Outsider drawn into the Swarm conflict
characters.motivation: She seeks answers without surrendering control of her identity.
characters.relationships: Her family, JD, and Del give competing stakes to that search.

updates.text: Her mother’s final message ties her family to the Locust’s leadership.

characters.name: Del Walker
characters.motivation: Curiosity and loyalty guide how he responds to military and personal crises.
characters.relationships: JD and Kait are his closest companions.

characters.name: Gabe Diaz
characters.motivation: He puts the needs of his people ahead of a clean institutional story.
characters.relationships: His family links the prequel to Kait’s generation.

factions: The Coalition of Ordered Governments is humanity’s central military power, but its survival policies carry consequences.
The underground enemy and a related transformed threat drive the original trilogy.
Independent settlements and a new enemy frame the later generation’s conflict.
timeline_help: Release order is the recommended first journey. Story order puts E-Day, Judgment, Tactics, and RAAM’s Shadow before the first game. Judgment’s Aftermath portion overlaps Gears 3, so the entries are not a frame-by-frame chronology. The starting-route filter includes both generations and E-Day as alternatives.
scope: Covers the major shooter campaigns, selected story DLC, and Tactics. Reloaded and Ultimate Edition are versions of Gears of War. E-Day’s status is dated to 3 October 2026; its ending is not summarised. Multiplayer seasons, books, comics, and Gears POP! are not required. Gears 5’s late survival choice remains player-dependent.
